_comment: OWNED-STORES REGISTRY (tallow.modisoft_insights). Copy to ~/.config/tallow/owned_stores.json (or point TALLOW_OWNED_STORES at it) and replace every entry with stores YOU own or operate. The connector REFUSES every credentialed call (login/fetch/logout) for a (client_code, store_id) that is NOT listed here — no registry entry means no login, no fetch. Entries below are schema samples only.

stores.display_name: PLACEHOLDER - replace with your own store
stores.owner_note: Schema sample only. Remove before use; list only stores you own.
